pages.title: Computronium Ingot
pages.text: Matter arranged for the greatest possible computation per gram, approaching the physical limits set by quantum mechanics and thermodynamics. Every atom is a logic gate, every bond a wire. It is warm to the touch, because it is thinking, and it never quite stops.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Once I had built a Computronium Block, breaking it into ingots by hand was straightforward. Each ingot carries a working fragment of the computation, which is useful in the machines that need it.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Superintelligence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Computronium Block, Quantum Processor, Reality Lattice Casing, Superintelligence Core, Superposition Crystal.
